source: 548 Governor of the Sea
target: 548 Praefectus Maris

source: 548 Governor of the Sea
target: 548 Praefectus Maris

source: Injured?
target: Vulneratus?

source: Injured by the humanoid lizard?
target: Vulneratus a lacerta homini simili?

source: Lumian made a casual guess after hearing Lugano’s judgment.
target: Lumian, postquam iudicium Lugani audivit, coniecturam levem fecit.

source: He stood by the carriage, his gaze naturally surveying the surroundings of the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Stabat iuxta currum, oculos naturaliter versus circumiecta sedis Praefecti Maris intendens.

source: The location was close to the fishing village’s docks, with boats sailing into the sea and fishing nets secured to the reefs.
target: Locus erat prope portus vici piscatorii, ubi naves in mare navigabant et retia piscatoria ad scopulos alligata erant.

source: Around nearby houses, women were busy processing seafood, turning them into salted fish and jerky.
target: Circa domos proximas, feminae opera elaborandi cibaria marina agebant, ea in pisces salsos et siccos transformantes.

source: Children ran along various village roads, playing games.
target: Pueri per varias vias vici currabant, ludos ludentes.

source: Though different from Cordu, the essence of the scene remained similar.
target: Quamquam a Cordu diversa, essentia scaenae similis manebat.

source: In front of the Governor of the Sea’s residence stretched a sizable square where Lumian and the others awaited Madame Martha, Rubió Paco, and their emergence.
target: Ante sedem Praefecti Maris forum amplum se extendebat, in quo Lumian et ceteri Madame Martha, Rubió Paco, et eorum adventum exspectabant.

source: Children gathered in a corner, arranging numerous shells and engaging in an acting game.
target: Pueri in angulo congregati, multas conchas disponentes et ludum scaenicum ludentes.

source: The eldest, dressed in a linen shirt, declared, “I’m the Governor of the Sea!”
target: Puer senior, tunica lintea indutus, declaravit: “Ego Praefectus Maris sum!”

source: “I’ll be the guard!”
target: Ego custos ero!

source: “I’m the mother,” the other children replied.
target: “Ego mater sum,” responderunt ceteri pueri.

source: The youngest hopped around, asking, “What about me? What about me?”
target: Puer minimus saltans, rogans: “Quid de me? Quid de me?”

source: The child playing the role of the Governor of the Sea pondered for a moment and said, “You can be the Child of the Sea.”
target: Puer, qui partes Praefecti Maris agebat, paulisper meditatus est et dixit: “Potes esse Puer Maris.”

source: Child of the Sea? What’s that?
target: Puer Maris? Quid hoc est?

source: Lumian, though not looking, listened intently to the children’s discussion.
target: Lumian, quamquam non spectabat, attenter sermonem puerorum auscultavit.

source: These kids may not understand many terms, but their lack of confidentiality made them unwitting carriers of information.
target: Hi pueri fortasse multa verba non comprehendebant, sed eorum secretum retinendi carentia eos inconsulte notitiae portatoribus faciebat.

source: The adults in Milo Village wouldn’t be overly vigilant against such young children, who might inadvertently reveal details remembered in their daily games.
target: Adulti vici Milo non nimis vigilant contra tales pueros parvos erant, qui forte in ludis quotidianis singula nota pateficere possent.

source: Recalling his experiences in Cordu, Lumian recognized the value of sounding out children and playing games with them.
target: Experientias in Cordu recolens, Lumian agnovit pretium puerorum audendi et ludendi cum illis.

source: It was a subtle way to glean insights into family matters.
target: Era subtilis modus ad res familiares cognoscendas.

source: After absorbing the children’s discussions and gauging the time, Lumian adjusted his golden straw hat and headed straight for the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Postquam sermonem puerorum absorpsit et tempus aestimavit, Lumian pileum stramineum aureum suum regulavit atque recta via ad sedem Praefecti Maris contulit.

source: Lugano was taken aback and swiftly followed Lumian.
target: Lugano obstupefactus est et celeriter Luminum secutus est.

source: Two “guards” in brownish-green shirts and pants, each armed with a rifle, blocked the entrance of the cathedral and sacrificial ground, fixing their gaze on Lumian.
target: Duo custodes, induti tunicis et braccis fusco-viridibus, quarum singuli sclopetos gerebant, ostium cathedralis et area sacrificii obstruxerunt, oculos in Luminum fixantes.

source: “Halt!” the “guards” shouted.
target: “Sta!” clamaverunt custodes.

source: Undeterred, Lumian continued forward, speaking in Intisian nonchalantly, “I don’t understand what you’re saying.”
target: Ne perturbatus, Lumian progreditur, loquens Intisiane non sollemne: “Non intellego quid dicatis.”

source: With a swoosh, the two “guards” raised their rifles, aiming at the outsider in the golden straw hat.
target: Subito, duo custodes sclopeta erexerunt, ad externum in pileo stramineo aureo intenti.

source: Lugano hurriedly translated, “They won’t let you in.”
target: Lugano festinanter interpretatus est: “Non sinent te intrare.”

source: Ignoring his guide, Lumian neither sped up nor slowed down as he approached the white building with gray bricks.
target: Neglegens ducem, Lumian neque celeravit neque tardavit, dum ad aedificium album lateribus griseis instructum accedebat.

source: A cold glint flickered in the blue eyes of the two “guards” as they squeezed their triggers.
target: Dum manubrios stringebant, fulgor frigidus in oculis caeruleis duorum custodum micuit.

source: At that moment, the outsider in the golden straw hat vanished from their sight.
target: Illo momento, externus in pileo stramineo aureo ex conspectu eorum evanuit.

source: He melded into the sunlit shadows of the governor’s residence.
target: Se in umbras solis illustratas sedis Praefecti absorpsit.

source: In the next instant, Lumian reappeared from a shadow in the foyer behind them and continued walking.
target: In proximo momento, Lumian ex umbra atrii post eos iterum apparuit et ambulare continuavit.

source: It was as if the distance between them had been erased.
target: Quasi distantia inter eos deleta esset.

source: The two “guards,” with keen senses, quickly turned around, peering behind them. However, Lumian had already entered the building, leaving the foyer.
target: Duo custodes, sensibus acutissimis, celeriter conversi sunt, post se speculantes; sed Lumian iam in aedificium intraverat, atrium relinquens.

source: Outside, Lugano stood in a daze, uncertain whether to take the risk of following and acting as a translator or to prioritize his own safety.
target: Foris, Lugano stupefactus stabat, dubiens an periculum sequeretur ac fungendo munere interpreti, an propriam salutem praeferret.

source: After passing through the foyer, Lumian suddenly noticed the space ahead darkening.
target: Postquam atrium pertransiit, Lumian subito animadvertit spatium ante se obscurari.

source: The dome, just over ten meters tall, emanated an inaccessible aura.
target: Cúpula, paulo plus quam decem metris alta, aura inaccessibilis emanabat.

source: Aqua-blue walls adorned with various reliefs caught his eye.
target: Muri caeruleo-aquae, variis effigiis ornati, oculos eius ceperunt.

source: Unlike the typical statues of Angels and Saints, these depicted objects from the sea—
target: Contra statuas angelorum et sanctorum consuetas, haec obiecta maris depingebant—

source: starfish, corals, numerous fish, lobsters, and crabs.
target: Asterias, coralla, pisces multi, astaci, et cancri.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian sensed the reliefs coming to life, casting a dangerous gaze at him.
target: Simul, Lumian sensit reliefia animari, atque in eum oculos periculosos iacere.

source: No, they weren’t alive.
target: Minime, non erant vivi.

source: The building itself seemed alive, instinctively rejecting intruders and exerting layers of pressure.
target: Aedificium ipsum quasi vivantem videbatur, instinctive intrusos reiciebat atque strata pressurarum exercebat.

source: Lumian’s steps instantly became heavy, as if burdened by hundreds of kilograms of food.
target: Gressus Luminiani statim graviores facti sunt, quasi centum modis cibi onerati.

source: Within his field of vision, Martha, the Paco family’s matriarch, knelt diagonally on the ground with her legs crossed.
target: In conspectu eius, Martha, matriarcha familiae Paco, in terra diagone genua flectit et crura sua transversa posuit.

source: Rubió Paco stood at a distance.
target: Rubió Paco loco remoto stetit.

source: The two maids also knelt, their backs turned towards the entrance hall, as if unwilling to look at a certain important figure.
target: Duae ancillae quoque in genua ceciderunt, tergum ad atrium convertentes, quasi figurae certae magni momenti inspicere non velint.

source: Directly opposite the high dome lay a “carpet” made of fish skin.
target: Contrario directe cúpulae altae, iacebat tapete ex cute piscium confectum.

source: A young man in a retro white robe reclined on it, propping himself up with his elbows as he quietly observed Martha.
target: Iuvenis in vestitu albo retroposito super illud recubuit, cubitis innixus, dum tranquille Martam contemplabatur.

source: Four other beautiful women adorned the “carpet.”
target: Quattuor aliae feminae pulchrae tapetem ornabant.

source: One knelt behind the lad, serving as his cushion.
target: Una post puerum in genua cecidit, quasi eius pulvinar fungens.

source: Another peeled late-ripened grapes and delicately fed them to the lad.
target: Altera uvas sero maturatas depilavit et leviter puerulo dedit.

source: The remaining two held trays with alcohol, food, and towels, each standing in a separate spot.
target: Duae reliquae patinas tenebant, in quibus alcoholum, cibus, et lintea erant, singuli in diversis locis statentes.

source: Their pregnant bellies were unmistakably visible, radiating a maternal glow.
target: Ventres eorum, gravidique, manifeste apparebant, maternum splendorem diffundentes.

source: Upon Lumian’s sudden entrance, the lad appeared alarmed, sitting up straight and seeking solace in the embrace of the woman behind him.
target: Ad subitum ingressum Luminiani, puer consternatus apparuit, recta sedens et solacium in amplexu feminae post eum quaerens.

source: Sensing the abnormality, Rubió turned around and saw the adventurer he had hired, Louis Berry.
target: Anomaliam sentiens, Rubió se convertere fecit et adventatorem quem conductum habuerat, Louis Berry, conspexit.

source: His pupils dilated slightly as he urgently spoke in Intisian, “Why did you come in?”
target: Pupillae eius paulo dilatatae erant, dum festinanter in Intisiana loquebatur: “Cur intravisti?”

source: Only then did Lumian pause and smile.
target: Tum demum Lumian subsedit et subridens.

source: “I’m a professional adventurer. You’ve been inside for too long. I’m worried something might happen.”
target: “Adventator professionalis sum. Intra nimis diu mansistis. Vereor ne quid eveniat.”

source: As he spoke, Lumian sensed dangerous gazes from various parts of the building.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian aspectus periculosos ex variis partibus aedificii sensit.

source: Rubió fell silent for a moment before saying, “Don’t worry. Just wait outside for us to come out.”
target: Rubió paulisper tacuit, deinde dicens: “Noli timere. Sola extra exspecta ut nos exeamus.”

source: “Alright,” Lumian chuckled, turned around, and sauntered into the foyer, acting as if the dangerous gazes didn’t exist.
target: “Bene,” subridens Lumian dixit, se convertit atque in atrium ambulavit, quasi aspectus periculososi non exsisterent.

source: Back in the foyer, he faced the two “guards” and their rifles without giving them a glance as he walked past.
target: In atrio reversus, se opposuit duobus custodibus et eorum sclopetis, eosque nullo quidem aspectu attento transeundo.

source: The expressions of the “guards” shifted, but they refrained from firing, allowing Lumian to exit the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Vultus custodum commutati sunt, sed ignem non fecerunt, sinentes Luminum domum Praefecti Maris exire.

source: Lugano breathed a sigh of relief, grateful he wouldn’t be hunted down by the people of Milo Village.
target: Lugano suspiravit leviter, gratus quod a populo vici Milo non insequeretur.

source: Despite being a Beyonder, facing more than one armed soldier still made him uneasy.
target: Quamquam Beyonder erat, adversus plures milites armatos se opponere eum tamen perturbabat.

source: Glancing at Lumian, he hesitated to ask why his employer insisted on barging in.
target: Aspiciens in Luminum, dubitavit rogare cur dominus eius irrumpere insisteret.

source: Lumian settled back beside the carriage driver, tucking in his legs with one bent and the other extended, allowing his right arm to rest on it.
target: Lumian se recubavit iuxta aurīgum currus, genu alterum flectens, alterumque extendens, sinens dextro brachio in eo quiescere.

source: After nearly ten minutes, Rubió Paco and his mother, Martha, emerged from the cathedral-like building.
target: Post fere decem minuta, Rubió Paco et mater eius, Martha, ex aedificio simile cathedrali emerserunt.

source: Rubió took a deep look at Lumian and said, “Let’s go. The Governor of the Sea has agreed to let my mother receive treatment at the Church.”
target: Rubió Luminum diligenter contemplatus est et dixit: “Eamus. Praefectus Maris consensit ut mater mea in Ecclesia curationem accipiat.”

source: Is that lad the current Governor of the Sea?
target: Num puer iste praesens Praefectus Maris est?

source: He looked weak and appeared panicked.
target: Videbatur infirmus et consternatus apparuit.

source: How can he protect Port Santa’s fishermen and sea merchants for a year?
target: Quomodo possit piscatores Portus Santae et mercatores maris per annum protegere?

source: Or does he lack abilities but possess a special symbol?
target: An ei facultates desunt, sed symbolum speciale possidet?

source: Did the April Fool’s prank cause an accident at last year’s sea prayer ritual?
target: Num iocus Aprilis Stultorum casum in ritu precationis maris anni praeteriti effecit?

source: This Governor of the Sea might have failed to receive the sea’s boon or appointment, but the Fisheries Guild members conceal the matter to avoid causing panic, treating him as the real Governor of the Sea.
target: Hic Praefectus Maris fortasse dona maris non accepit, sed sodales Gildis Piscandi rem occultant ne pavor oriantur, eum tamquam verum Praefectum Maris tractantes.

source: He must know about what happened back then…
target: Oportet eum scire quid tunc acciderit…

source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
target: Lumian cogitabunde annuit.

source: He smiled and asked Rubió in Intisian, “Then, should we thank Earth Mother for Her love and care or the Governor’s approval?”
target: Subridens, Lumian Rubió Intisiana lingua rogavit: “Ergo, gratias agamur Matri Terrae pro amore et cura, an approbationi Praefecti?”

source: Rubió didn’t respond and followed his mother, Martha, into the carriage.
target: Rubió non respondit et matrem suam, Martha, in currum secutus est.

source: Lugano hurriedly took a seat on the other side of the carriage driver, watching as the horse circled around and changed direction, gradually departing from the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Lugano festinanter sedit in altera parte aurīgī, spectans equum circumagere et directionem mutare, paulatim a sede Praefecti Maris discedens.

source: Phew… Lugano sighed from the bottom of his heart.
target: Phew… Lugano ex imo corde suspiravit.

source: This commission doesn’t seem dangerous…
target: Haec commissio non periculosum videtur esse…

source: Apart from his employer insisting on barging into the Governor of the Sea’s residence, there were no surprises.
target: Praeterquam quod dominus eius irrumpere in sedem Praefecti Maris insistit, nulla erant inopinata.

source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “That’s because I’m here. If it were just you, those hidden observers might have already come knocking.”
target: Lumian subridens induxit et dixit: “Idcirco quia ego adsum. Si solus esses, illi observatores occulti fortasse iam ad ianuam pulsavissent.”

source: Lugano fell silent, observing as his employer pointed at the Governor of the Sea’s mansion, resembling a cathedral, and uttered a phrase in Highlander word by word.
target: Lugano tacuit, observans ut dominus eius in mansionem Praefecti Maris, quae cathedrali similis erat, indicaret et verba in lingua Highlander singula proferret.

source: “What. Will happen if. Blown up?”
target: “Quid. Accidet, si explositus fueris?”

source: Lugano shuddered, his hair standing on end.
target: Lugano contremuit, et capilli eius erecti sunt.

source: He glanced at the astonished carriage driver and advised his employer in Intisian, “You’ll probably be hunted down by the entire Port Santa.”
target: Aspectans aurīgum currus stupitum, dominum eius in Intisiana admonuit: “Forsitan totus Portus Santa te insequentur.”

source: Lumian smiled and averted his gaze, remaining silent.
target: Lumian subridens oculos avertit atque silentium retinuit.

source: Only then did Lugano realize.
target: Tum demum Lugano intellexit.

source: His employer was testing someone!
target: Dominus eius aliquem probabat!

source: Why else would he use Highlander, a language he hadn’t mastered yet?
target: Cur aliter utaretur lingua Highlander, quam nondum perit?

source: He was testing the reactions of the carriage driver and Madame Martha in the carriage!
target: Probabat reactiones aurígī et Madame Marthae in curru!

source: Listening to Martha and Rubió’s conversation, Lumian noted the mother and son barely spoke during the journey, perhaps due to Martha’s poor health, with occasional moans of pain.
target: Audiens sermonem inter Martha et Rubió, Lumian animadvertit matrem et filium vix loqui in itinere, fortasse ob mala valetudine Marthae, cum interdum gemitibus doloris.

source: As the carriage left Milo Village, the driver suddenly pulled the reins, stopping the horses.
target: Dum currus vicum Milo relinquit, aurīgus repente funibus traxit, equos sistens.

source: An old man with a black cane had appeared in front of the carriage.
target: Senex cum baculo nigro ante currum apparuit.

source: With dark and white hair, eyes as blue as the sea, and wearing common fishermen’s clothes, the wrinkled face of the old man could have killed a mosquito with its folds.
target: Capillis atris et albis, oculis tam caeruleis quam mare, et vestimenta piscatorum communia gerens, vultus rugosus senis muscam per plicas interficere potuisset.

source: “Mr. Oro…” the carriage driver whispered, his expression tense, uncertain how to react.
target: “Domine Oro…” sussurravit aurīgus currus, vultu tenso, nesciens quomodo ageretur.

source: Juan Oro? Lumian thought. The president of the Fisheries Guild and the former village chief of Milo Village?
target: Juan Oro? Lumian cogitavit. Praeses Gildis Piscandi et pristinus dux vici Milo?

source: Supported by a young man resembling him, Juan Oro approached the Paco family’s carriage with his cane.
target: Iuveni, qui eum similis erat, Juan Oro cum baculo suo ad currum familiae Paco appropinquavit.

source: In the carriage, Rubió and Martha remained silent.
target: In curru, Rubió et Martha taciti mansērunt.

source: At that moment, a revolver appeared on Juan Oro’s forehead, pressing the cold muzzle against his flesh.
target: Illo momento, apparuit revolver in fronte Juan Oro, cum tubus frigidus in carnem eius premens.

source: Lumian raised his chin slightly and looked at the president of the Fisheries Guild. With a calm expression, he asked, “Who allowed you to approach this carriage?”
target: Lumian mentum leviter erexit et praesidem Gildis Piscandi aspexit, vultu tranquillo, quaerens: “Quis tibi accessum huic currui permisit?”
